S45.01.needs: a file to upload and a model that supports edit
S45.01.note: The attached picture is used as the source image only when the selected image model supports edit; the composer shows a conflict notice otherwise.
steps: Sign in and open a new chat.
Click the + button in the composer and choose Add photos & files, then pick a PNG or JPG from your computer.
Click the + button again and choose Create image; the Image pill appears.
Type an instruction such as 'make the sky red' and press send.
Compare: the result is an edit of your uploaded picture, not a brand-new unrelated image.
S45.01.where: Chat composer > + menu > Add photos & files (attach your picture), then + menu > Create image, then type a change and send

S45.02.needs: an image generated in an earlier chat or in the Library
S45.02.note: The Remix row appears only for image items and only in hosts with an image composer; the New version route works from any chat that shows the image.
steps: Click Library in the left sidebar.
Find an earlier image and open its menu.
Click Remix.
Look at the composer: the image is attached and the Image pill is on.
Compare: the image is ready to be changed by the next message.
S45.02.where: Sidebar > Library > open an image item's menu > Remix (opens the image in image mode); or open the chat that made it and use New version on the image

labels.text: Apply this change to the image

S45.03.needs: a generated image and a model that supports edit
S45.03.note: When the model does not support edit, the same box generates a new image and the original is not changed.
steps: Open a chat that contains a generated image.
Hover over the image and click New version.
Type a change, for example 'add a hat'.
Click the send button (Apply this change to the image).
Compare: the image above is edited to match the change.
S45.03.where: Chat with a generated image > hover the image > New version > type in the box 'Describe a change to generate a new version...' > click the send button labelled Apply this change to the image

S45.05.needs: a generated image and a model that supports edit
S45.05.note: The area painter is shown only when the model supports edit; the app's own helper text warns that the rest of the image may change too.
steps: Open a chat with a generated image and click New version.
Click Select area.
Paint over the part of the image to change.
Type a change and send it (Apply this change to the image).
Compare: only the painted area is meant to change, though the guide notes nearby content may change too.
S45.05.where: Chat with a generated image > hover the image > New version > Select area

S45.10.needs: a generated image and a model that supports edit
S45.10.note: Clear selection is shown only while a selection exists.
steps: Open New version on a generated image.
Click Select area and paint a part of the image.
Click Clear selection.
Compare: the painted area disappears and the selection is empty; the Clear selection button goes away.
S45.10.where: Chat with a generated image > New version > Select area > paint an area > Clear selection

S45.15.note: No Remove background control was found. Searched for 'Remove background', 'background removal' and 'transparent background' in apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/ChatComposerNew.tsx and apps/web/features/chat/components/ImageGenerationCard.tsx. The only related control is the Transparent pill, which asks for a transparent background on a newly generated image, not removal from a chosen picture.

S45.16.needs: a generated image and a model that supports edit
S45.16.note: The composer does not offer outpainting (apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/ChatComposerNew.tsx comment); the card's aspect change calls buildReframeEdit with operation outpaint. The aspect control's visible words were not located.
steps: Open New version on a generated image.
Choose a different aspect ratio (the aspect control is inside the New version panel).
Apply the change with the send button (Apply this change to the image).
Compare: the image is extended to the new frame and the new area is generated to match.
S45.16.where: Chat with a generated image > New version > change the aspect ratio of the image > apply the change

S45.19.needs: a generated image and a model that supports edit
S45.19.note: Reframe uses the same aspect-change path as S45.16 (apps/web/features/chat/lib/imageGenerationOptions.ts); the aspect control's visible words were not located, and a tiny ratio change is skipped.
steps: Open New version on a generated image.
Choose a different aspect ratio.
Apply the change with the send button.
Compare: the same scene now fills the new frame, with no change to the content beyond the reframe.
S45.19.where: Chat with a generated image > New version > change the aspect ratio > apply the change

S45.22.needs: a reference picture file and a model that supports edit
S45.22.note: Searched for 'Reference' in apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/ChatComposerNew.tsx. Visible reference labels found ('Reference images', 'Reference image') belong to video mode only; the image-mode reference path (readReferenceImageAsBase64) has no visible label located.

S45.31.needs: a generated image and a model that supports edit
S45.31.note: Earlier versions are stored in message metadata (imageVersions in apps/web/features/chat/pages/WebChatPage.tsx).
steps: Open New version on a generated image and send a change.
When the new version appears, look for the group of version arrows under the image.
Click Previous version to see the earlier image.
Compare: the original image is still there next to the new result.
S45.31.where: Chat with a generated image > New version > send a change > use the Previous version arrow to see the earlier image

S45.33.note: The Transparent pill appears only when the image model supports edit; the alpha path through storage and download was not traced end to end.
steps: Click + > Create image, then turn on the Transparent pill and type a prompt.
Send it and wait for the image.
Download the image from the card.
Compare: the background is see-through, not white or filled.
S45.33.where: The result of a Transparent image (inner behaviour of the image pipeline); seen in the downloaded file
